issues.description: Duplicate React imports causing build failure - useState and useEffect imported twice from 'react'
issues.element: Import statements at top of page.tsx
issues.root_cause: Line 2 has 'import { useState, useEffect } from react' and line 4 has 'import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from react' - two separate import statements importing the same hooks. The source file shown only has line 4, but the console logs reveal line 2 also exists in the actual file on disk.

issues.description: Hydration mismatch - server renders 'Which room are we designing?' but client renders 'Style Quiz'
issues.root_cause: The phase state is initialized with a function that reads from useFingerprintStore, but the server doesn't have access to client-side store state, causing server to render a different phase than the client.

fixes.new_str:
"use client"
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
fixes.reason: Remove the duplicate import line that imports useState and useEffect from 'react' a second time, keeping only the consolidated import with all needed hooks.
Fix hydration mismatch by initializing phase to a static default value on both server and client, then updating it client-side in a useEffect after mount. This prevents server/client HTML mismatch.
